name: Code Review Required
description: Source Code requires a passed review, by a participant other than its author, addressing all prior findings, before Ready.

conditions.statement: At least one review_result with outcome Passed exists for the Work Item.
exceptionRules: Emergency hotfix, approved by an Authority holder, may defer review to within 24 hours post-release.

conditions.statement: The reviewing participant is not the same participant who authored the change.
All findings raised in a prior review round on this Deliverable are marked resolved or explicitly deferred with rationale.
